caption:
The video captures a close-up view of a metal wok filled with a colorful stir-fry mixture of sliced mushrooms, bell peppers, and green onions glistening with sauce. Thick white steam billows upward from the hot ingredients, which rest against the lower right side of the tilted vessel. A small, stray piece of green onion clings to the upper inner wall of the wok, staying attached through the early and middle frames.

As the sequence progresses, the orientation of the wok appears to shift, and the accumulated vegetables slide across the curved bottom surface toward the left side. The motion gradually accelerates, and the ingredients begin to climb up the inner wall on the left, blurring as they gain speed. The steam continues to rise heavily, partially obscuring the dark background. The food moves in a fluid cascade, transitioning from a resting pile to an active toss, with the individual pieces of mushroom and pepper becoming distinct yet blurred by the rapid movement against the dark metal.

Toward the end of the clip, the vegetables are launched into the air over the left rim, leaving the right side of the wok dark and empty.
